hints.title: Shared Depth Distinct Parent Obstacle
hints.text: Two nodes are cousins if they have the same depth but different parents. How can tracking each node alongside its parent during a tier-by-tier traversal verify both conditions simultaneously?

hints.title: Tier and Parent Invariant
hints.text: Cousins must appear on the same level and have distinct parents. If both targets are discovered in the same level queue, check that their recorded parents differ.

hints.title: Level-by-Level Cousin Check Procedure
hints.text: Traverse level by level using a queue storing (node, parent). At each level, inspect all nodes. If both x and y are found at the current level, return true if their parents are different, else false. If only one is found, return false.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

variables: N: number of nodes in tree (2 <= N <= 100)
complexity.notes: Breadth-first traversal recording parent pointers per level to verify depth match and parent distinction.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Only checking depth without parent verification falsely identifies siblings as cousins.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Returning false if one target is found on an earlier tier than the other.
